data.name: Filzah
data.gender_notes: Filzah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A precious gem or jewel, a treasure, a source of joy and protection. The name Filzah carries the meaning “Jewel, Treasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Filzah usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to a child believed to bring joy and protection, a reminder of the treasures and blessings in life.
data.etymology: Filzah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, Treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Filzah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
